messages:
Marie (Docs): Hey folks — opened PR #342 for the migration guide + SDK snippet updates. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/342

Marie (Docs): Can I get a reviewer for the SDK snippet and the Vale style bits? Hoping to merge today if CI is green.

docs-bot: Automated check: docs preview failed for PR #342. Jobs failing: linkcheck, vale. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/pr/342/logs

Alex (Eng): I can take the SDK snippet review. Can someone re-run the docs-preview job after fixes?

ci-bot: Rebuild queued for PR #342 by @alex. Job started (docs-preview).

docs-bot: linkcheck error: broken link found in migration.md -> ../models/deploy.md#scaling-capacity (HTTP 404)
docs-bot: vale error: 'utilize' flagged in migration.md line 45 (VALE:WRONGWORD).

Sam (SDK): Noted — the SDK example in the doc uses client.v0_8 import. We should update it to client.v0_9.0. Snippet that needs change:
```py
from redwood_sdk.v0_8 import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
```
Change to:
```py
from redwood_sdk.v0_9 import RedwoodClient
```
Also adjust method name from .run_sync to .generate.

Marie (Docs): Thanks, pushing fixes now. I corrected the broken link target (anchor changed after the deploy docs re-org) and replaced 'utilize' with 'use' per Vale. Also bumped the SDK snippet to v0.9.0. Commits: 7f8b2a3 (link + vale), a1c4d9f (sdk bump).

Alex (Eng): I'll review the new commit tomorrow morning (PT). If CI passes I can approve and merge after 14:00 PT today.

Rachael (Infra): Heads up — please don't merge directly into main until we cut release-v1.8 branch (scheduled for today at 15:30 PT). If this lands early we'll need a backport. Can we hold?

Oliver (PM): We need the updated docs for the customer demo at 16:00. Is there a way to get it into prod without merging to main?

Marie (Docs): I can hold the merge and we can promote the preview to the staging slot if infra ok with that.

Rachael (Infra): Staging promote is fine. Please hold on main until the branch is cut.

ci-bot: Docs preview succeeded for PR #342 — linkcheck passed, vale passed. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-342--docs.redwood.ai (build 873)

Alex (Eng): Quick pass done, LGTM. I'll approve once you confirm release branch is cut. :+1:

Marie (Docs): Release branch cut confirmed by release bot. Proceeding with your approval then. Thanks everyone! :pray:

Alex (Eng): Approved and merging in ~5 minutes (will monitor CI post-merge).

ci-bot: Merge completed: PR #342 merged into main by Alex (merge commit 3c9e7b2). Post-merge preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/upgrade-sdk (deployed)

Marie (Docs): Thanks all — follow-up: I'll open a tiny PR to backport the snippet change to release-v1.8 if needed.

Oliver (PM): Perfect, demo ready. :rocket:
